sermon.title: The Boy Jesus 02/16/2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the boy Jesus going to Jerusalem each Passover. The feasts picture Christ our Passover, unleavened sincerity and the firstfruits resurrection. When His parents lost Him for days, they found Him in the temple asking questions. Christians can lose Him without noticing; God wants to ask us questions and be heard in quiet obedience.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What was the Passover?
faqs.answer: The lamb’s blood kept the death angel out.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now the blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you; and the plague shall not be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

faqs.question: Pentecostals’ problem?
faqs.answer: Want Him to hear, not listen.

faqs.question: How to get understanding?
faqs.answer: Go to God’s house, worship, pray.
